en.title: Minutes Since the Day's Last Departed Bus
en.description:
Given the day's departure times and the current time, find how many minutes have passed since the most recent bus that has already departed. A bus departing exactly at the current time does not count as departed; if no bus has departed yet that day, return −1, without wrapping around to the previous day.

This site's standard input/output is stated explicitly; ranges not given by the source problem are marked as this site's conventions.
en.input: The first line contains n, followed by n lines of departure times in HH:MM format, and the last line contains the current time. The source has no upper bound; this site uses 0≤n≤100000 and times in 00:00..23:59. The list is given in non-decreasing time order and may contain duplicates.
en.explanation: Example 1: the most recent departure was at 14:00, 30 minutes ago. Example 2: the 14:00 bus does not count as departed yet, so only 12:30 counts, 90 minutes ago. Example 3: the bus at exactly 00:00 does not count as departed, and there is no earlier bus that day, so the output is −1.
hints: Convert the times to minutes since midnight, take the largest departure minute strictly less than the current minute, and subtract.
